original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Two SWAP targets in M_r(F2[GL_3(F2)]), all six coordinate-CNOT labels, r=2 or r=3, free scalar GL_r mixing and complete dirty restoration: exact six-call minimum.
scope_change_reason: The card permits a specified nonabelian alphabet. Expand PR1414 from the two GL2 coordinate CNOTs to all six GL3 coordinate CNOTs; keep two SWAP targets and bound the scalar register counts. The concurrent three-SWAP GL2 question was passed over at overlap check.
bottleneck_link: Scoped bit-mechanism cost screen: an optimistic free-scalar model already rejects a six-to-five paid-call saving. No physical supplier, paid recursive profile or kappa change is inferred; the selected complex side still binds.
stop_rule: Complete both five-call matrix-image censuses, formally check the direct six-call witness and controls, and stop. If a matrix-image candidate occurs, require full formal coefficients. Session budget 60 minutes, reserve final quarter for checking; hand off incomplete coverage.
evidence: PROOF.md and EXPECTED.json: exact balls of 853 and 17515 states, complete 30708 and 2942520 edge scans per implementation, zero target intersections, complete formal six-call upper bounds, 25 positive/boundary/model controls and seven focused test groups.
author: commdata2338
ai_assistance: Prepared for commdata2338 (@commdata2338), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Two code-disjoint implementations within the same AI-assisted session; no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can a second address spectator lower the two-SWAP cost?
